senses.gloss:
ऋषिः [cf. Uṇ. 4. 119]
—1 An inspired poet or sage, a singer of sacred hymns, (e. g. कुत्स,
 वसिष्ठ, अत्रि, अगस्त्य &c.). [These Ṛṣis form a class of beings distinct
 from gods, men, Asuras &c. (Av. 10. 10. 26). They are the authors or seers
 of the Vedic hymns; ऋषयो मन्त्रद्रष्टारो वसिष्ठादयः; or, according
 to Yāska, यस्य वाक्यं स ऋषिः, i. e. they are the persons to
 whom the Vedic hymns were revealed. In every Sūkta the ऋषि is mentioned
 along with the देवता, छन्दस् and विनियोग. The later works mention
 seven Ṛṣis or saptarṣis whose names, according to Śat. Br., are
 गौतम, भरद्वाज, विश्वामित्र, जमदग्नि, वसिष्ठ, कश्यप and अत्रि;
 according to Mahābhārata, मरीचि, अत्रि, अङ्गिरस्, पुलह, क्रतु, पुलस्त्य
 and वसिष्ठ; Manu calls these sages Prajāpatis or progenitors of
 mankind, and gives ten names, three more being added to the latter list,
 i. e. दक्ष or प्रचेतस्, भृगु and नारद. In astronomy
 the seven Ṛṣis form the constellation of “the Great Bear”; यत्रा
 सप्त ऋषीन् पर एकमाहुः Rv. 10. 82. 2.]
—2 A sanctified sage, saint, an ascetic, anchorite; (there are usually
 three classes of these saints); देवर्षि, ब्रह्मर्षि and राजार्षि;
 sometimes four more are added; महर्षि, परमर्षि, श्रुतर्षि and काण्डर्षि.
—3 A ray of light.
—4 An imaginary circle.
—5 A hymn (मन्त्र) composed by a Ṛṣi; एतद्वोऽस्तु तपोयुक्तं ददामीत्यृषिचोदितम्
 Mb. 12. 11. 18;
—6 The Veda; P. III. 2. 186.
—7 A symbolical expression for number seven.
—8 Life; Bhāg. 10. 87. 50.
—9 The moon.

ऋषिः + -कुल्या
—1 a sacred river.
—2 N. of महानदी, N. of सरस्वती; अथ तस्योशतीं देवीमृषिकुल्यां
 सरस्वतीम् Bhāg. 3. 16. 13.
ऋषिः + -कृत् a. making oneʼs appearance; Rv. 1. 31. 16.
ऋषिः + -गिरिः N. of a mountain in Magadha.
ऋषिः + -चान्द्रायणम् N. of a particular observance.
ऋषिः + -च्छन्दस् n. the metre of a Ṛṣi.
ऋषिः + -जाङ्गलः, -जाङ्गलिका the plant ऋक्षगन्धा. (Mar. म्हैसवेल).
ऋषिः + -जाङ्गलः, -जाङ्गलिका the plant ऋक्षगन्धा. (Mar. म्हैसवेल).
ऋषिः + -तर्पणम् libation offered to the Ṛṣis.
ऋषिः + -धान्यम् The grain Coix barbata (Mar. वरी).

ऋषिः + -पञ्चमी N. of a festival or ceremony on the fifth day in the
 first half of Bhādrapada (observed by women).
ऋषिः + -पुत्रकः Southern wood, Artemisia abrotanum (Mar. दवणा).
ऋषिः + -प्रोक्ता the plant माषपर्णी (Mar. रानौडीद).
ऋषिः + -बन्धु a. connected or related to the Ṛṣi; Rv. 8. 100. 6.
ऋषिः + -मनस् a. inspired; far-seeing, enlightened; Rv. 9. 96. 18.
ऋषिः + -मुखम् the beginning of a Maṇḍala composed by a Ṛṣi.

ऋषिः + -यज्ञः a sacrifice offered to a Ṛṣi (consisting of a prayer
 in low voice). Ms. 4. 21.
ऋषिः + -लोकः the world of the Riṣis.

ऋषिः + -श्राद्धम् Funeral oblations for the Ṛṣis. a figurative expression
 for insignificant acts which are preceded by great preparation.

ऋषिः + -श्रेष्ठः + ({@-ष्ठम्@}) The pod of Helicteres isora: also the
 shrub of tree (Mar. मुरुडर्शेग).

ऋषिः + -श्रेष्ठः + ({@-ष्ठम्@}) The pod of Helicteres isora: also the
 shrub of tree (Mar. मुरुडर्शेग).

ऋषिः + -स्तोमः
—1 praise of the Ṛṣis.
—2 a particular sacrifice completed in one day.
ऋषीतत a. Celebrated by the (sacred) sages.

ऋषीवत् a. Praising Ṛṣi; associated with Ṛṣis; शिप्रिन्नृषीवः
 शचीव्रो Rv. 8. 2. 28.
ऋषीवन् a. Ved. Accompanied by sages.

ऋषि(षी)कः
—1 A Ṛṣi of a lower degree.
—2 N. of a country or its inhabitants (pl.).

ऋषि(षी)कः
—1 A Ṛṣi of a lower degree.
—2 N. of a country or its inhabitants (pl.).
ऋषिका f. A female author composing the Ṛks e. g. Viśvārā, Romaśā &c.
